# Brewio

> Brewio is a coffee journal and brew timer for iPhone. You log what you brew and how it tasted, follow recipes with a step-by-step timer, and keep track of the beans you have at home. It is free, with an optional Brewio Pro subscription, and available in 15 languages. Made in Sweden.

## Features
- Brew journal: beans, roaster, dose, water, grinder and grind setting, temperature, brew time, TDS and extraction yield, rating and tasting notes for every brew, plus coffees drunk at cafés
- Step-by-step brew timer with water targets for each pour, for 20 methods: V60, Origami, Kalita Wave, April Brewer, Kalita 102 / Melitta, Chemex, Hario Switch, Clever Dripper, Nel Drip, drip bags, AeroPress, French press, siphon, drip machine, moka pot, espresso, freddo espresso, ibrik / cezve, cold brew and cold drip
- Custom recipes, hot and iced versions, a ratio calculator and an extraction yield calculator
- Bean stash: grams left after each brew, days since roast, cost per cup, a reminder when a bag gets old, past bags, and label scanning to fill in a bag's details
- Taste profile, origin map, statistics, a weekly recap and dial-in tips for sour or bitter cups
- Beanie, a small plant in a coffee cup that grows as you log brews, with stickers and seasonal outfits
- Your grinders with their own settings, share images for Instagram stories and posts, data export (CSV and JSON), and an evening streak reminder
- A list of 57 specialty roasters the Brewio team recommends, with what they focus on and where they ship; nobody pays to be listed

## Free and Pro
- Free: 15 brews a month, the last 30 brews in the journal, 3 bags, 1 recipe and 1 grinder, every brew method and the timer, the ratio calculator, Beanie, stickers and the roaster list
- Brewio Pro (monthly or yearly): unlimited brews, history, bags, recipes and grinders, photos, label scanning, taste profile, origin map and full stats, weekly recap, extraction yield calculator and dial-in tips, past bags, data export, and choosing Beanie's stickers

## Availability
- iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/app/brewio-brew-track/id6762492301
- Android: not available yet
- Sign-in: Apple or Google. Data is stored on Supabase servers in the European Union.
- Languages: English, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, German, Dutch, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Greek, Turkish, Japanese and Korean

## Free tools (no sign-up)
- [Coffee Ratio Calculator](https://brewio.app/tools/coffee-ratio-calculator/): Coffee-to-water ratio for 12 brew methods
- [Coffee Grind Size Chart](https://brewio.app/tools/grind-size-chart/): Grind scale from Turkish-fine to cold-brew coarse
- [Extraction Yield Calculator](https://brewio.app/tools/extraction-yield-calculator/): TDS% to EY%, filter and espresso modes
- [Brew Timer](https://brewio.app/tools/brew-timer/): Step-by-step timers for 12 methods
